title: Exact entire proper-face traces for anisotropic Lipschitz extensions and a dependent outside-face PCC failure
status: FULL7-unit new ROOT working proof and exact diagnostic, UNREVIEWED

units.statement: Setting and uniform distance from a cell to its actual proper face.
units.proof:
Let sigma be a nonempty closed rational convex polyhedral cell, V=aff(sigma), tau a nonempty face and H=aff(tau). Choose a rational origin in tau and a rational splitting V=W plus N, W the tangent space of H. Write points as (t,s), with H={s=0}, and use the block coordinate l1 norms. These coordinates and norms are rational; an arbitrary Euclidean metric is handled by fixed finite-dimensional norm-equivalence constants, not an irrational orthogonal projection in a rational-geometry assertion. Since tau is a face, sigma intersect H=tau: an exposing form vanishes on H and is nonnegative on sigma, so the intersection lies in its exposed face, and use all exposing forms if tau is lower-dimensional. Conversely tau is contained in the intersection.

Write sigma={A_t t+A_s s<=b}. The restrictions A_t t<=b cut out tau inside H. For y=(t,s) in sigma, the maximal positive violation of that restricted system at t is at most J||s||_1, with J=max row ||A_s,row||_infinity. There is a finite constant K such that a point z in tau can be selected with ||t-z||_1<=K||s||_1, hence ||y-(z,0)||_1<= (K+1)||s||_1.

Here is the full ordinary distance argument, so no named error-bound theorem is imported. For a nonempty relative Euclidean polyhedron P={n_j x<=b_j}, take a nearest z and w=x-z. The finitely generated cone of active outward normals is closed: reduce any nonnegative representation to independent columns by moving along a dependence until one coefficient vanishes; along a convergent represented sequence pass to one fixed surviving independent subset, whose inverse bounds/converges its coefficients. If w is outside this cone, separation gives a direction v with all active n_j v<=0 and w.v>0. Inactive rows have strict slack, so z+epsilon v is feasible for small epsilon, contradicting nearestness by first variation of squared distance. Therefore w=sum_active lambda_j n_j, lambda>=0. Independent-column reduction gives sum lambda<=A||w||, uniformly over finitely many subsets. Consequently ||w||^2=sum lambda_j(n_j x-b_j)<=A delta(x)||w||, delta=max(0,max violations), proving dist(x,P)<=A delta. Use norm equivalence to replace Euclidean distance by l1. Apply this to the restricted tau system and delta<=J||s||_1. If dim H=0 take z=0,K=0. If tau=H the distance is zero. Constants depend fixed cell/face geometry only.

units.statement: Finite exact convex Lipschitz extension using an anisotropic rational polyhedral norm.
units.proof:
Let f be finite continuous convex on sigma and GLOBAL L-Lipschitz in the block l1 norm. This is an EXPLICIT hypothesis of this lemma; working299 suggests supplying it from positive balancing and bounded affine difference, but remains UNREVIEWED and is not a premise by label. Choose rational M>L and rational B>L, and put N(t,s)=M||t||_1+B||s||_1. Define F(x)=inf_{y in sigma}(f(y)+N(x-y)).

Choose y0 in sigma. The global Lip inequality gives f(y)>=f(y0)-L||y-y0||_1. Since N>=L||.||_1, triangle inequality yields F(x)>=f(y0)-L||x-y0||_1. Evaluating at y0 gives a finite upper bound, so F is finite everywhere. Using epsilon-minimizers for two points, convexity of f and N, and the convex combination of their feasible y's proves convexity of F. The inequality N(x-y)<=N(x'-y)+N(x-x') and its reverse prove |F(x)-F(x')|<=N(x-x'); hence F is globally Lipschitz and continuous. At x in sigma the same Lip bound gives f(y)+N(x-y)>=f(x); y=x gives equality, so F|sigma=f EXACTLY. This proof does not require attainment for the general f and does not assign MA to F. Intermediate F need not be PA.

The strict rational inequalities M,B>L are convenient but not mathematically necessary for finiteness/exactness. Coordinates are rational and the norm has rational walls, but f itself is not thereby made a rational-carrier PA function.

units.statement: Exactly one entire affine-face trace, and preservation of bounded supports on the ACTUAL face.
units.proof:
Use K from E0 and additionally choose B>=L(K+1)+MK. For x=(h,0) in H and y=(t,s) in sigma choose z in tau as E0. Then
f(y)>=f_tau(z)-L(K+1)||s||_1,
M||h-t||_1>=M||h-z||_1-MK||s||_1.
Thus f(y)+N(x-y)>=f_tau(z)+M||h-z||_1+[B-L(K+1)-MK]||s||_1. Infimizing and using the converse choices y=(z,0) proves EXACTLY
F|H=g_M, where g_M(h)=inf_{z in tau}(f_tau(z)+M||h-z||_1).
The preceding E1 proof on tau shows that g_M is finite convex Lipschitz on ALL H and equals f_tau on the ENTIRE actual face tau. If finitely many cells sigma_i have the same actual face tau and common f_tau, choose one rational tangent M and sufficiently large separate B_i. Their full-affine F_i therefore have the SAME trace g_M on ALL H, not only on finitely many contacts, even if the normal spaces are dependent.

Suppose at each y in tau an ambient p_y supports f_i on ENTIRE sigma_i for all i, and these forms have a uniform finite coordinate bound. Increase M so it bounds every tangent coordinate of p_y; increase each B_i so it bounds every coordinate on that cell's chosen normal complement, while retaining the trace inequality. Then p_y(v)<=N_i(v) for all v in V_i. For every z in sigma_i,
f_i(z)+N_i(x-z)>=f_i(y)+p_y(z-y)+p_y(x-z)=f_i(y)+p_y(x-y).
Taking infima and using F_i(y)=f_i(y) proves that the SAME ambient p_y supports all F_i on ENTIRE V_i, for EVERY original y in tau. The form's common ambient origin is retained; different coordinate splittings only change its coordinate bound.

No claim of a common support at y in H outside tau follows. g_M there includes new slopes imposed by the norm, and those slopes can have no compatible ambient lifts. E5 gives an explicit failure. Shared entire affine traces and original-face supports are therefore distinct conditions. Working299 proposes uniform p_y on a balanced support, but is not treated as an accepted grant here.

units.statement: An exact proper auxiliary reference, with bounded difference on the whole affine hull and the same entire trace.
units.proof:
Suppose an actual REAL affine ell on sigma satisfies ell_linear(w)>0 for EVERY nonzero w in rec(sigma), and |f-ell|<=C on sigma. Choose G bounding the absolute coordinate slopes of ell, then M,B>max(L,G), and increase B so it also satisfies G(K+1)+MK. Define
Gamma(x)=inf_{y in sigma}(ell(y)+N(x-y)).
The E1 proof with Lip constant G gives finite convex Lipschitz Gamma and Gamma|sigma=ell EXACTLY. Infima preserve two-sided inequalities, so Gamma-C<=F<=Gamma+C on ALL V. In contrast with an arbitrary auxiliary floor, no modification of the actual f on sigma occurs. E2 applied to ell gives Gamma|H=Gamma_H, Gamma_H(h)=inf_{z in tau}(ell_tau(z)+M||h-z||_1). If the actual affine references agree on tau, they agree as affine forms on H. With one M and sufficiently large B_i, ALL full affine references Gamma_i therefore have the SAME Gamma_H on ENTIRE H.

These references are proper with positive recession in every nonzero direction of their respective full affine hulls. Here is the global quantitative proof. Positivity of ell_linear on the compact unit section of rec(sigma) gives a positive minimum if that section is nonempty. Choose c below this minimum. If ell(y)>=c||y||_1-D failed for all finite D, an unbounded offending sequence, normalized along a subsequence, would give a unit w in rec(sigma) with ell_linear(w)<=c. This contradicts the choice of c. If rec(sigma)={0}, the same normalized-sequence argument proves sigma bounded, so any c>0 works with finite D. Thus ell(y)>=c||y||_1-D on sigma. Since N>=m||.||_1 with m=min(M,B)>0,
ell(y)+N(x-y)>=min(c,m)||x||_1-D.
Infimizing proves Gamma(x)>=min(c,m)||x||_1-D. The same estimate makes minimizing y's bounded for fixed x; continuity/closedness gives attainment. Exact affine recession on original sigma is retained because Gamma=ell on ALL sigma.

Each Gamma_i is a proper full-page convex reference. Their union along common H has equal values, but it need NOT be PC when normal spaces are dependent, as E5 explicitly shows. It is not an admitted global replacement for the original gamma on the entire balanced space. This distinction prevents a premature invocation of a whole-book approximation theorem or MA completion.

units.statement: The auxiliary Gamma is genuinely finite REAL PA on rational spatial geometry, even for actual irrational ell slopes.
units.proof:
We supply a primal generating proof to avoid comparing real slopes and creating unjustified irrational walls. A nonempty rational polyhedron sigma is conv{q_a}+cone{r_b} for finitely many rational GENERATING POINTS and rational recession directions, including opposite directions for lineality. The points need not be vertices of a polyhedron with lineality. For completeness, quotient rational lineality of a homogeneous rational inequality cone; on its pointed quotient the sum of nonnegative defining forms is positive away from zero. Its level-one section is bounded (normalize an unbounded sequence to contradict positivity), closed and compact. A nonvertex of that compact rational polytope has an active-equation null direction; move in both signs to new active endpoints and induct on lower faces until full-rank rational vertices remain. Lift through a rational complement and restore opposite lineality rays. Homogenize A y<=bt,t>=0 to obtain rational points from positive-height generators and rational recession directions from zero-height generators. This proves the points-plus-recession statement without the false vertices-with-lineality sentence identified in the incomplete native222 audit; that audit is not used as a mathematical grant.

Because ell is affine,
epi(ell+indicator_sigma)=conv{(q_a,ell(q_a))}+cone{(r_b,ell_linear(r_b)),(0,1)}.
All spatial coordinates are rational, while the heights are the actual REAL values. The weighted block l1 norm has epigraph cone generated by (+/-e_j,N(e_j)) and (0,1); these spatial coordinates and heights are rational since M,B are rational. Minkowski addition gives
epi(Gamma)=conv{(q_a,ell(q_a))}+cone{(r_b,ell_linear(r_b)),(+/-e_j,N(e_j)),(0,1)}.
Indeed the sum consists exactly of the costs ell(y)+N(x-y) with upward heights, and E3 gives attainment and finite lower fibers. A finite cone is closed by the independent-column proof of E0, and its sum with a compact hull is closed by subsequence compactness. Thus this is the ACTUAL epigraph, not merely its closure or a rec-domain guess.

Every lower face supported by (p,-1) uses a subset of these finitely many generating points/rays, excluding the vertical ray. Its spatial projection is a rational hull plus rational cone despite actual real heights. On such a graph face projection is injective. A point in two projected faces has one height, so their intersection is the projection of their common face; restriction of the other face's real support to the graph makes this intersection a face of each projected polyhedron. Full-domain finite convexity supplies a nonvertical support at every graph point by local secant bounds/closed epigraph support. Hence finitely many projected lower faces form a genuine rational complex covering V, and Gamma is continuous real affine on each. Its compatibility equations between affine coefficients on common faces form a finite homogeneous system with rational coefficients. A rational kernel basis spans its real solutions; clear denominators to obtain integral lattice slopes and rational constants for basis functions. Gamma is therefore in the genuine finite REAL scalar extension on ONE rational carrier. No rational rounding of ell, irrational maximum-wall assertion or operator is used. The identical proof applies to Gamma_H.

units.statement: Exact dependent three-page diagnostic: common ENTIRE H traces and preserved original-face supports still allow a legal outside-face PCC cost -1/4.
units.proof:
In rational ambient R^3 use coordinates (t,a,b), common H the t-axis, and normals v1=(0,1,0),v2=(0,0,1),v3=(0,-1,-1), so sum v_i=0. In complete page V_i={t e0+s v_i} take the PROPER rational closed cell sigma_i={s>=0,0<=t+s<=1}. Their every pair intersection is tau={0<=t<=1,s=0}. Put f_i=ell_i=gamma_i=s on sigma_i. Each is convex and 1-Lipschitz in its (t,s) l1 coordinates, all traces are zero, all references have positive slope1 on their nonzero recession direction(-1,1), and |f-gamma|=0. The function is continuous printed-PC on the union of these proper cells: a legal center off tau has only its own page's assigned cells and affine Jensen; at a tau-center the value is0 and every endpoint value s>=0, so the inequality holds. At every original tau point the SAME ambient p=0 supports all f_i on entire sigma_i. The cells' other boundary facets are unbalanced: this is NOT an admitted global positive balanced original counterexample.

E0 has K=1: for y=(t,s), t lies between -s and1-s, so its distance to [0,1] is <=s. Choose M=2,B=4; B=L(K+1)+MK=4, both parameters exceed L=G=1. Every extension is
F_i(t,s)=Gamma_i(t,s)=inf_{0<=u<=1,r>=0}[r+2|t-(u-r)|+4|s-r|].
They are exact on sigma_i and have SAME ENTIRE H trace g(t)=2 dist(t,[0,1]), with all original tau supports p=0 preserved. For t+s<=0 and s>=0, minimization over u first gives u=0 whenever r<=-t. There the cost is -2t-r+4|s-r|, minimized at r=s, since its left slope is -5 and right slope3. For r>=-t, even allowing u in[0,1], the bound r+4(r-s)>=-5t-4s is >=-2t-s because t+s<=0; larger r cannot improve. Thus on the ENTIRE rational region s>=0,t+s<=0,
F_i(t,s)=-2t-s.
More directly for small s at t=-1 the same two-piece calculation gives F_i(-1,s)=2-s,0<=s<=1. On H t<0, F_i(t,0)=-2t.

Take the rational center x=(-1,0,0) and epsilon=1/4. Endpoints x_i=x+epsilon v_i are rational, have mean x, and lie in the respective rational regions s>=0,t+s<=0. These top regions contain the common negative H ray as a face. Refine the genuine rational PA carriers to include those regions and all common H walls; their face-interior at x remains incident to each endpoint's assigned region. Hence this is a LEGAL printed PCC, not a nonincident long chord. The center value is2 and every endpoint value is7/4, so
(1/3)sum F_i(x_i)-F(x)=7/4-2=-1/4.
The extensions' common trace is continuous finite real PA and the complete page cycle with arbitrary positive weights is balanced, but the glued F=Gamma is NOT PC. No MA is assigned to it.

The same failure appears in common-support coordinates. At a negative H point any supporting ambient form must have tangent coefficient q=-2. Let r_i=p(v_i); sum r_i=0. Supporting on the original points(-r,r) in sigma_i forces r_i<=-1, contradicting sum r_i=0. This argument explains why original-face supports alone cannot imply compatible lifts of the newly saturated trace slopes outside tau. It is a counterexample to an automatic full-page compatibility inference, not a failure of the exact single-cell extension lemma or original balanced regularization theorem.

units.statement: Precise relation to the ongoing original task and remaining global gluing gap.
units.proof:
E0-E4 establish full constructive convex extensions with common ENTIRE affine-face trace, actual original-cell equality, proper genuine rational-spatial REAL PA auxiliary references, bounded difference on full affine hulls and retention of the SAME original-face ambient supports. They require GLOBAL cellwise Lip as an explicit hypothesis. Whole new299 proposes that hypothesis and uniform support bounds for positive balanced embedded supports, but remains UNREVIEWED; this connection is not a grant. Working296 provides a different single-cell auxiliary extension and full-affine majorants, also UNREVIEWED.

The WHOLE mathematically accepted S291 with BOTH source and reader annotations can conditionally be used separately on each full affine (V_i,Gamma_i): its full-affine above-majorant construction gives globally uniform finite rational-spatial REAL PA convex approximants of F_i with exact actual recession and ANY finite prescribed rational contacts. Restricting to sigma_i preserves actual original gamma/recession and gives single-cell approximation. This does not automatically give exact common affine-face traces after approximation or preserve common support at every changed trace point. The new common trace g_M can already have incompatible dependent-page lifts OUTSIDE tau before approximation, and its glued auxiliary Gamma may fail PC, as E5 proves. Thus a whole-book theorem cannot be invoked merely from equal trace values and separate proper convex references. Independent quotient tangents would allow a common lift of arbitrary page supports sharing a trace slope, but that extra hypothesis is not imposed on a general balanced complex and cannot be silently inserted.

For multiple different shared faces, simultaneously choosing anisotropic norms to obtain every trace agreement is another unproved step. Applying E2 separately with different H splittings does not establish simultaneous exactness or a compatible convex extension. General all-face global REAL PA regularization and the original P05.1 full structural classification remain OPEN. No density claim for arbitrary raw discontinuous rational-endpoint PC, no nonPA contact classification, no literal-coefficient density and no broad compact/abstract generalization follows. Domain-first MA/R230/S272 applications are unavailable until a genuine global PC approximation has been proved. The E5 unbalanced original partial support cannot refute an original balanced hypothesis, while its full complete-page extension is balanced geometry but its proposed reference/function is nonPC and therefore excluded from the admitted theory.
